title: Canonical application-level performance authority
motivation: The historical F-AHL28C 75 percent same-key memoization gate compared memoized binding against the then-current warm-cache baseline. Later F-AHL35/F-AHL38 materially reduced the warm-cache comparator cost, so replaying the old relative bind gate against the improved comparator no longer measures the same repair effect.
frozen_fidelity: top and bottom flux delta <= 1e-5 cm/day

memoization_diagnostic.interpretation: provider-local reuse remains materially cheaper than a fresh warm-cache bind, but the old 0.25 relative threshold is not invariant to later optimization of the comparator
